blocks.goal: Reduce the size of HtmlTreeBuilderState by moving the large static Constants inner class to a dedicated top-level class to improve readability and separate data definitions from behavior.

ops.details: Create a new top-level class HtmlTreeBuilderStateConstants in package org.jsoup.parser that contains the same static final tag arrays (InHeadEmpty, InHeadRaw, InHeadEnd, AfterHeadBody, BeforeHtmlToHead, InBodyStartToHead, InBodyStartPClosers, Headings, InBodyStartLiBreakers, DdDt, InBodyStartApplets, InBodyStartMedia, InBodyStartInputAttribs, InBodyStartDrop, InBodyEndClosers, InBodyEndOtherErrors, InBodyEndAdoptionFormatters, InTableToBody, InTableAddBody, InTableToHead, InCellNames, InCellBody, InCellTable, InCellCol, InTableEndErr, InTableFoster, InTableBodyExit, InTableBodyEndIgnore, InRowMissing, InRowIgnore, InSelectEnd, InSelectTableEnd, InTableEndIgnore, InCaptionIgnore, InTemplateToHead, InTemplateToTable, InForeignToHtml) and preserve the exact string contents and ordering. Keep class package-private or public as needed to match access from HtmlTreeBuilderState.

Replace references to HtmlTreeBuilderState.Constants.<NAME> with HtmlTreeBuilderStateConstants.<NAME>. Add or update imports if necessary. Ensure fully-qualified references are updated in switch conditions and inSorted(...) calls.
Ensure both files are in package org.jsoup.parser and update imports if any external types are used by the extracted constants class (none expected).

blocks.goal: Group and move small, cohesive static helper methods out of the enum to reduce the enum's responsibilities: extract mergeAttributes, isWhitespace and HandleTextState into a dedicated utility class.

ops.details: Create a new utility class HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil in org.jsoup.parser containing the three static methods: mergeAttributes(Token.StartTag, Element), isWhitespace(Token) and HandleTextState(Token.StartTag, HtmlTreeBuilder, TokeniserState). Preserve method signatures, visibility (package-private/private -> package-private or public as needed), and any annotations (@Nullable). Ensure the utility class reuses the same types (Token, Element, HtmlTreeBuilder, TokeniserState, StringUtil) from the original file.

Replace internal calls to mergeAttributes(...), isWhitespace(...) and HandleTextState(...) with HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.mergeAttributes(...), HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.isWhitespace(...), and HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.HandleTextState(...) respectively. Update any private visibility to package-visible if necessary and add imports. Ensure that any references to TokeniserState or nullable annotations remain valid.

Add necessary imports in the new utility file (org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable, and any other referenced types that are not in java.lang or in the same package) and update the enum file imports if needed.

blocks.goal: Reduce the complexity of the enum by extracting the largest and most complex state's behavior (InBody) into a dedicated processor class. Replace the InBody enum constant's overridden process method with a delegate to the new processor. This reduces the enum size and groups cohesive parsing logic for InBody into its own class.

ops.details: Introduce a small interface HtmlStateProcessor in org.jsoup.parser with a single method: boolean process(Token t, HtmlTreeBuilder tb). This interface models the per-state processing contract already present on the enum and will be implemented by state processor classes.

Create a new top-level class InBodyProcessor in org.jsoup.parser that implements HtmlStateProcessor and contains the full logic extracted from the InBody enum constant's process method and its private helpers (inBodyStartTag, inBodyEndTag, anyOtherEndTag, inBodyEndTagAdoption, plus the MaxStackScan constant used only there). Preserve control flow and local helper methods as private methods inside InBodyProcessor. Use the same types (Token, HtmlTreeBuilder, Element, Tag, TokeniserState, ArrayList, Validate, Constants) and reference HtmlTreeBuilderStateConstants where needed (from block 1).

Modify the InBody enum constant implementation to delegate to the new processor: replace the overridden process(Token t, HtmlTreeBuilder tb) body with 'return new InBodyProcessor().process(t, tb);' or reuse a static singleton processor instance if desired. Ensure imports are updated and the enum still implements the abstract method. Keep other enum constants unchanged.

Add required imports in InBodyProcessor and update HtmlTreeBuilderState imports for HtmlStateProcessor and InBodyProcessor. Ensure references to Constants are updated to HtmlTreeBuilderStateConstants if block 1 applied.
